name: swe-flow
description: LLM authoring companion to the govkit governance engine. Skills drive the SDLC chain — goal-define, domain-decompose, api-designer, data-model, and spec-author (PRD/RFC/ADR/US) — plus workflow-author (scaffold reusable .claude/workflows/*.js orchestration), working-discipline (trigger-gated thinking checkpoints that cut agent error and escalation), distill-learnings (the R7 learning loop: distill the gate journal + escape log into proposal-only guardrail changes), and implementer/reviewer/doc-keeper/distiller agents. Authors artifacts and orchestration, calls `npx govkit verify`; never embeds the deterministic gate.
